node.statement: Fix an arbitrary real 0 < lambda < 1/2. By the external lem-prh-sharpness, choose positive unital maps A_lambda:l-infinity(2)->l-infinity(4) and M_lambda:l-infinity(4)->l-infinity(2) such that epsilon_lambda=||M_lambda A_lambda-I_2||_{infinity->infinity}=2*lambda^2 and such that its stated distance conclusion holds. Define eta_lambda:=2*lambda^2 and Q_lambda:=A_lambda M_lambda. Then eta_lambda=epsilon_lambda, and since lambda>0, lambda=sqrt(eta_lambda/2).
